title: Pocket agenda + action tracker — serving trio (Zara)
content:
Purpose:
Short pocket agenda for the weekly serving/infra/console sync. Use this as my speaking notes + live action tracker. Keep things tight (30–40m).

Context / framing:
- Focus: blockers that impact 99th latency and rollout safety for the hosted fleet.
- Quick sync to confirm canary plan for v0.23 kernels, decide fallback route, and agree on short-term monitoring tweaks.
- Triage-level items only; deep architectural debates moved to follow-up.

Quick wins since last week:
- Diego pushed hotfix to the batching gate (PR #987) — reduced warmup jitter on g5s by ~8%.
- Canary of model-quant-2 succeeded for <512 tokens, looking stable.
- Console: new token-level breakdown panel visible for alpha orgs.

Agenda (timeboxed):
1) 5m: Roll call + quick wins + infra incidents (who had tickets): Priya
2) 10m: Canary status for v0.23 kernels (metrics: 99th latency, error rate, memory OOMs) — Diego
3) 8m: Fallback routing decision (policy + region preferences) — quick vote
4) 7m: Console rollout checklist for token panel (safety toggle, RBAC, telemetry) — Zara
5) 5m: Action items review + owners + deadlines + blockers
6) remainder: Parking lot & follow-ups (async threads)

Deep-dive notes (prep bullets):
- Canary telemetry to highlight: p99-latency, p95-cold-start, kv-cache-hit, kv-evictions/min, gpu-util tail. Need visualization links for each.
- Fallback: propose route order: same-region cheaper-variant -> cross-region identical -> degrade to lower-capacity but stable model. Confirm SLO impact matrix.
- Console toggle: enforce opt-in via feature flag per-org; need an opt-out for privacy-sensitive orgs.

Pre-meeting asks (things I want teammates to paste into chat):
- Diego: paste last 24h canary graphs and link to the dashboard panel.
- Priya: list any active incidents with Sev >= 2 in last 7d.
- SRE (if present): confirm whether autoscaler had scale events triggered by canary traffic.

1:1 follow-ups to raise if time permits:
- Diego: kernel selection scheduler gap — remind about the profiling job I asked for; status? (ACTION: Diego — profiling job output, due 2026-03-16)
- Priya: console RBAC permission matrix draft — ask for example orgs to test ACLs. (ACTION: Priya — share matrix, due 2026-03-13)

Open questions (to capture in meeting):
- If fallback model is used, what is the user-visible difference to customers (latency, hallucination risk)? Need copy for incident comms.
- Is there any billing/metric churn when we switch routes mid-request? (Product econ ask)

Action items (live tracker — update during meeting):
- ACTION-101: Diego — post 24h canary dashboard links + attach raw p99 data. DUE: 2026-03-11. STATUS: in_progress.
- ACTION-102: Priya — produce RBAC test matrix and list of 3 orgs to validate. DUE: 2026-03-13. STATUS: todo.
- ACTION-103: Zara — draft fallback comms snippet for status page + internal runbook. DUE: 2026-03-12. STATUS: todo.
- ACTION-104: SRE (nominee: Ankur) — confirm autoscaler logs & whether scale events overlapped with canary spikes. DUE: 2026-03-12. STATUS: requested.
- ACTION-105: Runtime eng — run full quantized model regression on val-set (small batch) and report delta. DUE: 2026-03-15. STATUS: todo.

Risk register (short bullets):
- Risk: Canary spikes that only occur under rare sequence length distributions — mitigation: attach seq-length histogram to canary dashboards.
- Risk: Console rollout accidentally exposes token debug to non-alpha orgs — mitigation: toggle + audit log.

Parking lot (move to follow-ups):
- Longer discussion: kernel selection policy for mixed-arch models (schedule 45m deep-dive next week).
- UI: add a compact latency-sparkline to per-route card in console (tracked in CONSOLE-442).

Notes to self (ramble / quick reminders):
- Keep agenda tight. Avoid design sessions — move to async doc.
- If debate stalls on fallback order, call vote and record as open item for product.
- Bring the example customer story where a fallback saved SLO last month (good anecdote).

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy/paste in #serving-weekly thread):
"Notes: canary looks stable for p<512; fallback order agreed (same-region cheaper -> cross-region identical -> lower-capacity). Action owners: Diego(ACTION-101), Priya(ACTION-102), Zara(ACTION-103), Ankur(ACTION-104). Next review: 2026-03-18. If you have objections to fallback order, please DM or raise by EOD 2026-03-12."

Next sync prep (what I need before next meeting):
- Raw canary p99 table for last 7 days (per-zone), link + CSV.
- RBAC test results from 3 orgs.
- Draft status page comms + runbook snippet.

End of notes.

-- Zara
